column1: # Corpus for the differential checks in test/differential/README.md.
# One run per line: a case id, a network file relative to the repository root,
# and the options as space-separated `name` (a flag) or `name=value` tokens,
# using the snake_case option names of the Python and R APIs. The CLI and the
# JavaScript package get the same options as --kebab-case flags. Every run
# also gets seed=123 unless the line sets its own seed.
# Keep ids stable: release_differences.tsv refers to them.
